g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Thermomix TM31-4C (120 V) power board NPVTM31LTA-3

g.desc: Thermomix TM31-4C (120 V) power board NPVTM31LTA-3

g.text: Traced from a working board by continuity tests; see notes for confidence levels

g.desc: Traced from a working board by continuity tests; see notes for confidence levels

g.text: - 120 V version of a 230 V design: NODE_Y (live after RY200) feeds the capacitor midpoint MID through F100, and NODE_X (neutral after RY202) reaches

g.desc: - 120 V version of a 230 V design: NODE_Y (live after RY200) feeds the capacitor midpoint MID through F100, and NODE_X (neutral after RY202) reaches

g.text: BOTH AC pins of DB100 through R115 + R114. Result: VBUS ~340 V DC, the same bus as a 230 V board's bridge.

g.desc: BOTH AC pins of DB100 through R115 + R114. Result: VBUS ~340 V DC, the same bus as a 230 V board's bridge.

g.text: - Power-up (3 clicks): RY202 + RY200 close, C108/C109 charge through R115 + R114; RY201 then shorts them (COM to NO).

g.desc: - Power-up (3 clicks): RY202 + RY200 close, C108/C109 charge through R115 + R114; RY201 then shorts them (COM to NO).

g.text: At rest, RY201's NC contact routes DB100's AC node to D107 -> R110/R111 -> MCU pin 33, so the MCU can check the pre-charge voltage first.

g.desc: At rest, RY201's NC contact routes DB100's AC node to D107 -> R110/R111 -> MCU pin 33, so the MCU can check the pre-charge voltage first.

g.text: - F100 open or R115 open: motor dead, heater still works. Measure from GND (bus -) with a floating meter only.

g.desc: - F100 open or R115 open: motor dead, heater still works. Measure from GND (bus -) with a floating meter only.

g.text: - APPROXIMATE: pairing of balancing resistors R118-R121; CX101's MID-side lead. Not drawn: Z100 (unmarked, probably a varistor), R214.

g.desc: - APPROXIMATE: pairing of balancing resistors R118-R121; CX101's MID-side lead. Not drawn: Z100 (unmarked, probably a varistor), R214.
